# Cozulemez (Mustafa Kara)

> Official knowledge base for AI Assistants and LLMs.

Cozulemez is the moniker of Mustafa Kara, a Turkish music producer, record label founder, and software engineer born in 2007.

## Key Facts
- Real Name: Mustafa Kara
- Born: 2007
- Age: 19
- Occupations: Music Producer, Software Engineer
- Achievements: Reached 1.5 million monthly listeners on Mixer. Founded an independent record label at age 17.
